description: HSE approval date set to the version 1 date (2019-07-24): the indication is present on 2020-03-26 in version 1 of the treatment regimen (https://web.archive.org/web/20200326154150/https://www.hse.ie/eng/services/list/5/cancer/profinfo/chemoprotocols/breast/350%20pertuzumab%20and%20trastuzumab%20and%20chemotherapy.pdf). The regimen lists the reimbursement status of this indication as "Pertuzumab- Reimbursement not approved, Trastuzumab- Hospital, Chemotherapy- Hospital". Availability within the public health system confirmed by personal correspondence with the NCCP on 2026-11-03.
